_notes: Velvet Shackles, the wrap: the owner's flat-cel ribbon strip (shackle_ribbon.png, 1983x793, #00FF00, untracked 2026-10-04) as one drawing on one 2500x440 canvas. The ribbon is registered on the canvas centre and only scaled about it: 1.30 to 1.0 is the pull tight (f0-f4, f4 on the cue), f5 holds tight, f6-f7 the slack (1.12, 1.28). Scale is baked here because SpellLayer has no scale over life. The layers tilt it with `rotate` (back +, front -) so two bands cross over the legs; the ribbon does not bend, which is why it is a band and not a coil (art step 4). keyed green-soft keeps the gold stitching.
